name: What the sealed chest kept
summary: Inside the chest lie five objects from different lives: Sylvanas' blood; Arthas's badge from Uther; his training sword from Muradin; the locket Jaina once gave him; and a soul shard belonging to Alexandros Mograine. Together they uncover traces of the people who knew the prince before he became the Lich King, and of the people whom Frostmourne harmed. Each keepsake begins a separate return.
